title: Chapter 252
content:
Chapter 252

Among the Wushu schools, as the Taoist school with the longest inheritance and the deepest background, it naturally has its confidence.

Taoism is known as the ancestor of all laws, the source of all schools, and claims that all the hundreds of schools in the world come from Taoism. The tone can be described as extremely arrogant, but it has not aroused opposition from all schools in the world. It is really surprising.

But to say this, Taoism naturally has its basis.

Let me first talk about Confucianism and Mohism, both of which are the three major schools of thought in the world.

Confucianism, as a school of inheritance and extensive influence, if it follows the historical trajectory, it will even dominate the entire world.

However, there is a generally accepted fact, that is, many Confucian ideas are born out of Taoism. Moreover, Confucius, the patriarch of Confucianism, once studied under Lao Tzu's sect, and lamented that he was not as good as a disciple of Lao Tzu.

Therefore, there is nothing to dispute that Confucianism originated from Taoism.

Mozi, the founder of Mohism, was originally a disciple of Confucianism, but later he could not get used to the teachings of Confucianism, and slowly began to question it, and finally rebelled against Mohism, and established a Mohism by himself.

And in the process, Mozi absorbed Taoist concepts, mixed with some Confucian views, and his own ideas, forming today's Mohism.

Therefore, it is not impossible to say that Mohism came from Taoism.

Let's talk about the Yin Yang family today, not to mention that it was established hundreds of years ago by Taoist disciples.

As for other famous farmers, doctors and novelists, these schools, big and small, are basically more or less influenced by the various schools headed by Taoism.

So Taoism is called the ancestor of all dharmas and the source of all schools, so there is really nothing to say.

After careful calculation, the inheritance of Taoism can be traced back to Xuanyuan's era. Taoism originally originated from Xuanyuan's Huangdi Neijing, Fuxi's innate gossip, and Yi, as well as some ancient Qi refiners, all kinds of thoughts gathered together.

Inheritance can be said to have background, qualifications, and enough people to perfect it.

After thousands of years, the secret method of Taoism can be said to be the best among all the schools in the world. I am afraid that all the schools combined cannot compare with Taoism.

So if you get the support of Taoism, not only can you strengthen your background in masters, but you can also replenish your reserves of Taoism and many secret techniques.

Yuguo now doesn't have any superfluous Taoist methods, magic tricks.

The legacy left by the previous system is really too little, except for the so-called emperor's unique skill, which is a battlefield skill. As for the rest, I'm sorry, because I have been wandering for too long and have lost too much, and I have lost them all.

Therefore, everything needs to be supplemented slowly by Zhong Yu himself to make up for the shortcomings of Yu Guo.

And today's Taoism, it is the long drought and the rain, which fills up the shortcomings of the imperial country.

And the most important thing is that the Taoist martial arts are not those of the Jianghu people. They fight fiercely and bravely, and blindly pursue killing.

Taoism's unique skills are no longer considered martial arts, but a low-level self-cultivation method. Their attack methods are also magic techniques, not martial arts moves. In other words, all the first-class and unique skills in the current world, no matter what their form is, the real big moves are biased towards the concept of self-cultivation.

With the help of Taoism, the officers and soldiers of Yuguo can be familiarized with the methods of cultivation in advance, so that they can enter other cultivation worlds and lay a solid foundation for completely turning Yuguo into a cultivation empire.

Therefore, with the support of Taoism and Mohism, for Zhong Yu, the two biggest shortcomings have been supplemented, and the next thing is just to conquer and conquer.

For a cultivator, what is the most important thing to settle down? Taoism, supernatural powers, magic weapons, elixir. Now three of these four ingredients have been supplemented by Yuguo, and the remaining pills are within easy reach.

For Qin Shimingyue's world, asking them to refine any kind of magical medicine would be absolutely embarrassing, even the lower-level Foundation Establishment Pills were very difficult.

After all, without this huge world inheritance, there are various deficiencies in many aspects of cultivation and qi refining, Xunxian asked.

But some other low-level pills belong to the Qi refining stage, but many of them can be completed by Qi training alone, and even some pills in the foundation building stage, if you put in some hard work, and don't hesitate to fill up a lot of resources, if you concentrate on research, you can do it. It's not that they can't be researched.

In this world, the three most researched schools of medicine have all joined Yuguo. The Minister of Jin of the Yin Yang family, Lao Yun Zhongjun, is specialized in alchemy. And Taoism, as a professional Taoist priest, naturally has the means of alchemy. Even the Mo family, which specializes in mechanical techniques, has a person known as the Immortal Doctor joining.

The relationship between the Mo family and the current medical school is very close, and they are almost indistinguishable from each other. The current Patriarch of the Physician, who is also the master of the original Chinese medicine doctor Xian Duanmurong, has already begun to lead the Physician, slowly trying to integrate into the Mohist.

This world is too chaotic, without enough strength, it is impossible to survive.

Just like doctors, this school with superb medical skills plays a very important role for all the powerful and powerful in the world.

Their superb medical skills are often able to take back the life of one dignitary after another from the hands of the god of death. With this magical medical skill, every student of the medical family enters and exits the prince's mansion and becomes their guest of honor.

But now, with the development of centralization, the status of physicians has gradually decreased, and it is no longer as good as it was in the Spring and Autumn Period, or even the early Warring States period.

Up to now, the entire medical family has only Duan Murong's master, such a first-class master, the other disciples are also withered, it is difficult to maintain his glory as a school.

And around it, there are countless hunters watching, trying to eat him up.

If it weren't for the worries of those powerful and powerful people who were afraid to wipe out the doctors, and no one would come to treat them when they were sick, the doctors would have been wiped out long ago.

But even with the blessing of the powerful, the current situation of the doctor's family is not very good, it is in danger, and it may be destroyed at any time.

So after much deliberation, the medical school chose the Mohist ally as their ally, and wanted to merge the entire medical school into the Mohist school and depend on each other.

In the original book, it seems that this idea was successful, and Duanmu Rong became a leader of the Mohist family. Does this mean that the entire medical school will also be merged into the Mohist family?

Therefore, with the common allegiance of the world's three major forces that have profound research on medical alchemy, Yuguo's shortcomings in elixir are not very serious.

The difference now is just some Dan Fang and some unique medicines.

But these, as long as you find a cultivation world and search hard, you can solve them easily.
